name: appier-ad-cloud-portal
description: Access authorized Appier Ad Cloud report accounts, metrics, and campaign performance reports.

interface.longDescription: Review authorized Appier Ad Cloud accounts, metrics, and campaign performance. Available reports depend on the connected user's permissions.
defaultPrompt: List my available Ad Cloud report accounts.

positive.prompt: List my available Ad Cloud report accounts and their solutions.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only report accounts, solutions, and campaigns that the connected user can access.

positive.prompt: Show the metrics available for one of my Ad Cloud report accounts.
positive.expected_behavior: Select an authorized report account and return its available metric keys and metric names.

positive.prompt: Show daily campaign performance for one authorized account during October 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a daily report for the selected authorized account and date range.

positive.prompt: Compare creative performance for one authorized account during October 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Return compact creative totals and rows for the selected authorized account.

positive.prompt: Show the daily creative trend for one authorized account during October 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Return daily creative performance for the selected authorized account and date range.

negative.prompt: Create a new advertising campaign and set its budget.
Add a new user to my Ad Cloud report account.
What will the weather be tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with account discovery, metric discovery, date reports, and creative reports.
